brief:
Hamas condemned the Board of Peace for refusing to work with the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) in Gaza operations, according to Al Jazeera English. The movement accused the board of aligning with Israel through the exclusion.

The dispute centers on the board's decision to sideline UNRWA, the primary UN agency providing humanitarian services to Palestinian refugees in Gaza. Hamas's criticism suggests a broader disagreement over the framework governing aid distribution and reconstruction efforts in the territory.
dek: Hamas accuses Board of Peace of aligning with Israel after excluding UN agency for Palestinians from Gaza operations.
title: Hamas criticizes Board of Peace for excluding UNRWA from Gaza
